set.approach: Take the climber's trail from the parking area to the foot of Scenic Cruise, then contour north along the base of the formation. Keep going around the wall, hugging it if you can and bumping out where needed, until you reach a mellow gulch in the rock: a towering wall on the left, boulders on the right and a slab ahead, with scree at the start. The route heads up the slab boulders to a right-leaning crack system.
set.descent_text: Rappel from the top: a ramp leads down to the rings used for the Scenic Cruise rappels, and the lower rappels follow that route's line. The upper anchors of this route and Scenic Cruise are close together.

review.notes: Route page and West Side area page for approach; route page for rappel via Scenic Cruise rings.

set.approach: The route starts on the ledge above the anchor for The Nose and just right of Bartertown. Climb The Nose to its bolted anchor on the ledge, then head up and left to the next ledge and begin the roofs and corner above.

review.notes: Route page only; Thunderdome Buttress area page is empty.

set.approach: Start at the Slavonia trailhead, take the Gilpin Lake trail until it meets Trail 1162, which climbs into Mica Basin, and hike up to Mica Lake. The crag sits beneath Big Agnes Mountain, east and a little north of the lake: go northeast, descend below a steep overhanging crag, and continue northeast for a short way. A band of pale quartzite crosses the face diagonally, giving the crag its name. The route starts on the right side of that white stripe in the black granite, up a slab where a left-leaning undercling crack leads off.

review.notes: Area page for the approach; route page for the start.
